PROJECT_DESC: a Claude Code plugin that packages a reusable engineering-governance workflow (worktree->PR, Linear vertical-slice ticketing, the MCP Tool Gateway, wave planning, and Wiki docs) as installable, parameterized templates any repo can be stamped with
REPO_MAP:
.claude-plugin/marketplace.json   the crow-mind marketplace (lists the plugin)
plugins/crow-mind-workflow/        the installable plugin
  .claude-plugin/plugin.json       name + version (bumped per release)
  skills/                          init-repo, sync-baseline, version-check
  templates/                       the parameterized governance baseline to stamp
  wiki-templates/                  the Workflow / Home / _Sidebar wiki pages
  scripts/                         render, stamp, sync_baseline, publish_wiki, check-version
  hooks/hooks.json                 SessionStart version check
docs/                              LPD.md + wave.yml (planning)
